sentences: A pseudodeterministic randomized algorithm returns the same canonical answer with high probability on repeated runs of a fixed input.
For perfect matching, this demands reproducible selection of one matching rather than merely finding any valid matching.
The question asks for such an algorithm on general nonbipartite graphs using polynomially many processors and polylogarithmic parallel depth.
The source achieves this for bipartite graphs, but extending the selection mechanism must account for the additional structure of general matching.
A solution would give stable outputs from efficient parallel randomization and advance the relationship between matching algorithms and derandomization.
